2026-09-03.english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇：The Ant and the Grasshopper In a sunny meadow, a diligent ant toiled each day, storing grain for the coming winter. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger, while the ant enjoyed a warm, full burrow. The grasshopper learned that foresight and hard work are essential for survival. This ancient fable reminds us: today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 中文翻译：在一个阳光明媚的草地上，一只勤奋的蚂蚁每天辛劳，为即将到来的冬天储存粮食。一只无忧无虑的蚱蜢唱歌并嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。当雪覆盖田野时，蚱蜢因饥饿而颤抖，而蚂蚁享受着温暖而充实的洞穴。蚱蜢明白了远见和勤奋是生存的关键。这个古老的寓言提醒我们：今天的准备是明天的安全。 重点词汇：diligent (勤奋的), toil (辛劳), store (储存), mock (嘲笑), shiver (颤抖), foresight (远见), essential (必要的), fable (寓言), preparation (准备), security (安全)
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 勤奋的蚂蚁每天储存粮食。2. 蚱蜢嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。3. 远见和勤奋是生存的关键。 英译中：1. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. 2. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger. 3. Today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 填空：1. The ant ______ grain for the coming winter. (store的适当形式) 2. The grasshopper learned that ______ and hard work are essential. (根据文章填词)

📖 30天趣味记忆·第2篇
第2篇：The Courage to Start Many students fear the unknown, but every master was once a beginner. The first step is often the hardest, yet it sets the tone for the journey. Do not let temporary confusion blur your vision. Instead, embrace small progress daily. As you accumulate knowledge, your confidence will grow. Remember, the path to success is paved with consistent effort, not sudden leaps. Today, take one small action toward your dream. 中文翻译：许多学生害怕未知，但每个大师都曾是初学者。第一步往往最艰难，但它决定了旅程的基调。不要让暂时的困惑模糊你的视野。相反，拥抱每天的小进步。随着知识的积累，你的信心会增长。记住，通往成功的道路是由持续的努力铺就的，而非突然的飞跃。今天，为你的梦想迈出一小步。 重点词汇：fear (v. 害怕), unknown (n. 未知), master (n. 大师), beginner (n. 初学者), tone (n. 基调), confusion (n. 困惑), blur (v. 使模糊), embrace (v. 拥抱), accumulate (v. 积累), confidence (n. 信心), consistent (adj. 持续的), effort (n. 努力), leap (n. 飞跃).
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 每个大师都曾是初学者。2. 不要让暂时的困惑模糊你的视野。3. 通往成功的道路是由持续的努力铺就的。 英译中：1. The first step is often the hardest. 2. Today, take one small action toward your dream. 3. Your confidence will grow as you accumulate knowledge. 句子填空：1. Do not let temporary ______ blur your vision. (confusion) 2. The path to success is paved with ______ effort. (consistent)
